guard: the shipped provider client posts runtime requests over the real manager-authority transport
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/auth/smoke/remote-exchange.smoke.ts

mutations.name: shipped runtime client never posts to the transport
mutations.find: return postManagerAuthority(endpoint, idpUrl, authorization, request, what) as Promise<RemoteManagedAgentRuntimeResult>;
mutations.replace: void postManagerAuthority; return { endpoint, idpUrl, authorization } as never;
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: the shipped provider client reaches the stock route and surfaces its unimplemented refusal
mutations.cell: the shipped provider client reaches the stock route and surfaces its unimplemented refusal

why: The mutation returns without posting, so a manager would never reach the host. The suite drives the registered provider over the real daemon and names the refusal it must surface.
